description: List all energy meters, optionally filtered by kind.

kind.description: Optional meter kind: electric, gas, water, or solar.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of meter objects sorted by name.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full meter object.

kind.description: One of electric, gas, water, solar.

currency_rate_per_unit.description: Cost per unit (e.g. USD per kWh).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new meter.

description: List raw readings, optionally filtered by meter_id and/or ISO date range.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of readings sorted by timestamp asc.

description: Record a new reading for a meter. Updates the meter's current_reading and derives cost from the meter's rate.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new reading.

description: Return the most recent reading for the given meter.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the latest reading object.

description: Compute total consumption and cost for a meter between the first and last readings in the given window.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output has {meter_id, start, end, consumption, cost, readings}.

description: List bills, optionally filtered by meter_id and/or status.

status.description: Optional bill status: unpaid, paid, or overdue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of bills sorted by period_end desc.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full bill object.

description: Generate a new unpaid bill for a meter over the given ISO date period from the readings in that window.

period_start.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) start of the billing period.

period_end.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) end of the billing period.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new bill.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated (paid) bill.

description: List alerts, optionally filtered by is_active.

is_active.description: Optional; true for active alerts only, false for inactive.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of alerts.

description: Create a new alert on a meter with a numeric threshold.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new alert.

description: Enable or disable an alert (flips is_active).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated alert.

description: Compare consumption/cost of two ISO time periods for the same meter.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output has {meter_id, period_a, period_b, delta_consumption, delta_cost}.

description: Aggregate counts of meters, readings, bills, alerts and current unpaid totals and active-alert counters.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is an object of aggregate counters.
